==Overview==
<div style="float:right; width: 400px; clear: right;">{{CaptionedImage|file=Synod_Summer_385YE.png|caption=The [[statement of principle]] allows an assembly to guide the people of the Empire.|align=right|width=400}}</div>
These pages are all related to [[the highest calling]] of the assorted [[Synod]] assemblies. Each assembly except the General Assembly, and the national assemblies of Wintermark, Urizen, and Varushka. Each of the other assemblies has an opportunity to declare a highest calling which will guide the efforts of that assembly in the year that follows.
